firstExtract.text: First extract on the books for {raider_name}. Desperanza would clap, but everyone is busy pretending this is normal.
{raider_name} made it home alive for the first time. The Hatch Authority hates setting expectations this early.

entries.text: Five successful extracts for {raider_name}. Desperanza now calls this 'concerning competence.'
Ten extracts logged. {raider_name} is becoming proof that bad ideas can be repeatable.

firstDeath.text: First official death for {raider_name}. Desperanza has processed the paperwork and several feelings.
The first death has been logged. In Desperanza terms, that means the career has truly started.

entries.text: Five deaths deep, {raider_name} is no longer unlucky. This is a management pattern.
Ten deaths on file. The recovery cot in Desperanza is considering a naming rights deal.
Third successful extract from {zone_name}. {raider_name} now calls it a route. Everyone else calls it a phase.
Five returns from {zone_name}. The zone is starting to feel less like a destination and more like a bad commute.
Third death tied to {zone_name}. That place and {raider_name} are building a relationship nobody approves of.
Five deaths in {zone_name}. Desperanza now files trips there under 'predictable mistakes.'
Home stash water bottle count reached {water_count}. This has stopped being preparedness and started being theology.
{water_count} water bottles in storage. The Water Ration Desk would like a private word and a public audit.
Water bottle total: {water_count}. At this point {raider_name} isn't hoarding. They're founding a religion.

nemesisEstablished.text: Nemesis update: {robot_name} has downed {raider_name} {count} times and is now the machine to beat, avoid, or resent professionally.
A pattern has emerged. {robot_name} keeps putting {raider_name} on the floor. Desperanza calls that a rivalry.

entries.text: {robot_name} has downed {raider_name} {count} times now. This is no longer bad luck. This is recurring programming.
Five documented downings by {robot_name}. Desperanza is considering assigning the feud its own file cabinet.
